q: Apa yang terjadi pada objek kalimat aktif ketika kalimat itu diubah ke bentuk pasif?
opts: Objek dihapus sepenuhnya
Objek berpindah jadi subjek kalimat pasif
Objek berubah jadi kata keterangan
Objek tetap di posisi yang sama
explain: Inti dari passive voice adalah memindahkan objek kalimat aktif ke posisi subjek kalimat pasif, sementara subjek aktif (pelaku) pindah ke belakang jadi agent (didahului "by", opsional).

q: Rumus umum kalimat pasif adalah...
opts: S + V + O
O + be + V1 + (by + S)
O + be + V3 + (by + S)
S + be + V-ing + O
explain: Rumus umum passive voice: objek kalimat aktif (jadi subjek baru) + be (disesuaikan tense) + V3 (past participle) + "by + agent" yang sifatnya opsional.

q: Ubah ke bentuk pasif: "The teacher checks our homework every day."
opts: Our homework checks by the teacher every day.
Our homework is checked by the teacher every day.
Our homework was checked by the teacher every day.
Our homework is checking by the teacher every day.
explain: "checks" = Simple Present. Rumus pasif Simple Present: S + is/am/are + V3. Subjek baru "our homework" (dianggap tunggal) → "is checked".

q: Ubah ke bentuk pasif: "They are building a new bridge."
opts: A new bridge is built by them.
A new bridge was being built by them.
A new bridge is being built by them.
A new bridge has been built by them.
explain: "are building" = Present Continuous. Rumus pasifnya: S + is/am/are + being + V3 → "is being built".

q: Ubah ke bentuk pasif: "She has written three novels."
opts: Three novels are written by her.
Three novels have been written by her.
Three novels had been written by her.
Three novels have written by her.
explain: "has written" = Present Perfect. Rumus pasifnya: S + has/have + been + V3. Subjek baru "three novels" (jamak) → "have been written".

q: Ubah ke bentuk pasif: "Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone."
opts: The telephone invents by Alexander Graham Bell.
The telephone is invented by Alexander Graham Bell.
The telephone was invented by Alexander Graham Bell.
The telephone has invented by Alexander Graham Bell.
explain: "invented" = V2, Simple Past. Rumus pasifnya: S + was/were + V3. Subjek baru "the telephone" (tunggal) → "was invented".

q: Ubah ke bentuk pasif: "Someone was watching the house."
opts: The house was watched by someone.
The house was being watched by someone.
The house is being watched by someone.
The house had been watched by someone.
explain: "was watching" = Past Continuous. Rumus pasifnya: S + was/were + being + V3 → "was being watched".

q: Ubah ke bentuk pasif: "The thief had stolen the money before the police arrived."
opts: The money was stolen before the police arrived.
The money has been stolen before the police arrived.
The money had been stolen before the police arrived.
The money had stolen before the police arrived.
explain: "had stolen" = Past Perfect. Rumus pasifnya: S + had + been + V3 → "had been stolen". "before the police arrived" tetap aktif karena "arrive" intransitif.

q: Ubah ke bentuk pasif: "The company will launch a new product next month."
opts: A new product will launch next month.
A new product is launched next month.
A new product will be launched next month.
A new product will have launched next month.
explain: "will launch" = Simple Future. Rumus pasifnya: S + will + be + V3 → "will be launched".

q: Ubah ke bentuk pasif: "They are going to repair the bridge."
opts: The bridge is going to repair.
The bridge is going to be repaired.
The bridge was going to be repaired.
The bridge is repaired.
explain: "are going to repair" = Simple Future (going to). Rumus pasifnya: S + is/am/are + going to + be + V3 → "is going to be repaired".

q: Ubah ke bentuk pasif: "They will have completed the project by next year."
opts: The project will be completed by next year.
The project will have completed by next year.
The project will have been completed by next year.
The project has been completed by next year.
explain: "will have completed" = Future Perfect. Rumus pasifnya: S + will + have + been + V3 → "will have been completed".

q: Manakah bentuk pasif yang benar untuk kalimat dengan modal "must"? "You must finish the work by tomorrow."
opts: The work must finish by tomorrow.
The work must be finished by tomorrow.
The work must been finished by tomorrow.
The work is must finished by tomorrow.
explain: Passive dengan modal selalu: modal + be + V3, tanpa perubahan bentuk modal itu sendiri. "must be finished" adalah bentuk yang benar.

q: "This problem ___ solved in different ways." (modal: can)
opts: can be
can been
can is
is can
explain: Rumus modal passive: modal + be + V3. "can be solved" adalah bentuk yang benar — "be" tidak berubah bentuk apapun setelah modal.

q: Manakah bentuk pasif yang benar dari "might have sent" (modal perfect)?
opts: might be sent
might have been sent
might has sent
might be being sent
explain: Modal perfect passive: modal + have + been + V3. "The letter might have been sent already" adalah bentuk yang benar.

q: "The teacher gave the students a new assignment." Manakah bentuk pasif yang PALING natural (subjek = objek orang)?
opts: A new assignment was given the students.
The students were given a new assignment.
The students gave a new assignment.
A new assignment gave the students.
explain: Untuk kata kerja berobjek dua (give, send, show, dst.), bentuk pasif yang paling natural dipakai penutur asli adalah objek orang jadi subjek: "The students were given a new assignment (by the teacher)."

q: "The teacher gave the students a new assignment." Manakah bentuk pasif kedua yang juga benar (subjek = objek benda)?
opts: A new assignment was given to the students.
A new assignment was given the students.
A new assignment gave to the students.
The students was given to a new assignment.
explain: Bentuk pasif kedua (subjek = objek benda) butuh preposisi "to" sebelum objek orangnya: "A new assignment was given to the students (by the teacher)."

q: Preposisi apa yang dipakai setelah kata kerja "buy" ketika membentuk pasif kedua (subjek = objek benda)? Contoh: "He bought his mother a gift." → "A gift was bought ___ his mother."
opts: to
for
by
of
explain: Kata kerja seperti buy, make, cook, find memakai preposisi "for" di pasif kedua, berbeda dari give/send/show/tell/offer/lend yang memakai "to".

q: "He got fired last week." Kalimat ini adalah contoh dari...
opts: Active voice biasa
Get-passive, alternatif informal dari be-passive
Kesalahan tata bahasa
Present Perfect pasif
explain: "got fired" adalah get-passive — versi informal dari "was fired", biasa dipakai dalam percakapan sehari-hari untuk kejadian tiba-tiba/negatif, bukan di tulisan formal.

q: Di konteks manakah get-passive ("got fired", "got hurt") SEBAIKNYA dihindari?
opts: Percakapan santai dengan teman
Tulisan formal, akademik, atau berita
Obrolan keluarga di rumah
Chat informal dengan teman sekelas
explain: Get-passive adalah bentuk informal — di tulisan formal/akademik/berita, penutur asli tetap memakai be-passive standar ("was fired", bukan "got fired").

q: Kenapa kalimat "The accident was happened yesterday." SALAH?
opts: Karena "yesterday" tidak cocok dengan Simple Past
Karena "happen" adalah kata kerja intransitif, tidak punya objek, jadi tidak bisa dipasifkan
Karena harus pakai "were" bukan "was"
Karena kalimat pasif tidak boleh punya keterangan waktu
explain: "happen" tidak diikuti objek (intransitif), jadi tidak ada apapun yang bisa dipindah jadi subjek pasif. Kalimat yang benar tetap aktif: "The accident happened yesterday."

q: Manakah dari kata kerja berikut yang TIDAK BISA dipasifkan karena intransitif?
opts: eat
write
arrive
build
explain: "arrive" adalah kata kerja intransitif (tidak punya objek) — tidak bisa dipasifkan. eat, write, dan build semuanya bisa diikuti objek, jadi bisa dipasifkan.

q: "She ___ late." (arrive, dalam bentuk yang benar, Simple Past)
opts: was arrived
arrived
was arriving passively
is arrived
explain: "arrive" intransitif, tidak bisa dipasifkan sama sekali. Bentuk yang benar tetap aktif Simple Past: "She arrived late."

q: Kapan sebaiknya kita TETAP menyebutkan "by + agent" di kalimat pasif, bukan menghilangkannya?
opts: Selalu, tidak ada pengecualian
Ketika pelakunya adalah informasi penting/relevan yang ingin disampaikan
Hanya di kalimat pertanyaan
Tidak pernah, "by + agent" selalu opsional dan boleh dihilangkan
explain: "By + agent" boleh dihilangkan kalau pelakunya tidak diketahui/tidak penting/sudah jelas dari konteks, tapi harus dipertahankan kalau siapa pelakunya justru bagian penting dari informasi yang disampaikan (mis. "The novel was written by Andrea Hirata.").

q: Manakah kalimat yang PALING tepat digunakan ketika siapa pelakunya sama sekali tidak diketahui?
opts: Someone stole my wallet yesterday.
My wallet was stolen yesterday.
My wallet stole yesterday.
My wallet is stealing yesterday.
explain: Kalau pelakunya tidak diketahui, passive voice tanpa "by + agent" adalah pilihan paling natural: "My wallet was stolen yesterday."

q: Temukan kesalahan pada kalimat: "The report is wrote by her yesterday."
opts: "be" (is) tidak cocok dengan signal word waktu "yesterday" (Simple Past)
Kata "by" seharusnya dihilangkan
Subjeknya seharusnya "he" bukan "her"
Tidak ada kesalahan
explain: "yesterday" adalah signal word Simple Past, jadi "be" yang dipakai harus "was", bukan "is". Bentuk benar: "The report was written by her yesterday."

q: Perbaikan yang tepat untuk "The house was build in 1990." adalah...
opts: The house was built in 1990.
The house is build in 1990.
The house was building in 1990.
The house has build in 1990.
explain: Kata kerja setelah "be" pasif harus V3, bukan V1. "build" adalah V1; V3-nya "built" (build–built–built).

q: Manakah pasangan V1-V2-V3 yang BENAR untuk kata kerja "write"?
opts: write - writed - writed
write - wrote - written
write - wrote - wrote
write - written - wrote
explain: "write" adalah kata kerja tidak beraturan: write (V1) – wrote (V2) – written (V3). V3 "written" yang dipakai dalam bentuk pasif.

q: Manakah pasangan V1-V2-V3 yang BENAR untuk kata kerja "build"?
opts: build - builded - builded
build - built - built
build - built - builded
build - build - built
explain: "build" adalah kata kerja tidak beraturan dengan V2 dan V3 yang sama: build – built – built.

q: Kalimat "The novel 'Laskar Pelangi' was written." terasa kurang lengkap ketika konteksnya justru menekankan siapa penulisnya. Perbaikan yang tepat adalah...
opts: The novel 'Laskar Pelangi' was written by Andrea Hirata.
The novel 'Laskar Pelangi' is written.
Andrea Hirata was written the novel 'Laskar Pelangi'.
The novel 'Laskar Pelangi' writes by Andrea Hirata.
explain: Kalau nama penulisnya adalah informasi penting yang ingin disampaikan, "by + agent" wajib dicantumkan, bukan dihilangkan.

q: Manakah kalimat pasif yang benar dari: "The government is going to build a new hospital."
opts: A new hospital is going to build by the government.
A new hospital is going to be built by the government.
A new hospital is built going to by the government.
A new hospital was going to be built by the government.
explain: Rumus pasif untuk "going to": S + is/am/are + going to + be + V3. "build" → V3 "built".

q: Ubah ke bentuk pasif: "Scientists have discovered a new species of frog."
opts: A new species of frog is discovered by scientists.
A new species of frog has been discovered by scientists.
A new species of frog was discovered by scientists.
A new species of frog had been discovered by scientists.
explain: "have discovered" = Present Perfect (subjek jamak "scientists", tapi objek barunya "a new species" tunggal → "has been discovered").

q: Ubah ke bentuk pasif: "Indonesia gained independence in 1945."
opts: Independence gains by Indonesia in 1945.
Independence is gained by Indonesia in 1945.
Independence was gained by Indonesia in 1945.
Independence has gained by Indonesia in 1945.
explain: "gained" = V2, Simple Past. Rumus pasif Simple Past: S + was/were + V3 → "was gained".

q: Temukan kesalahan: "Many guests was invited by the local chief."
opts: "be" (was) tidak cocok dengan subjek jamak "many guests", seharusnya "were"
"invited" seharusnya "invite"
"by" seharusnya dihilangkan
Tidak ada kesalahan
explain: "be" pada kalimat pasif harus menyesuaikan jumlah subjek barunya. "Many guests" jamak, jadi butuh "were", bukan "was".

q: Temukan kesalahan: "The details of the incident will be explain by the committee soon."
opts: "will" seharusnya "would"
"explain" seharusnya "explained" (bentuk V3)
"by" seharusnya "from"
Tidak ada kesalahan
explain: Kata kerja setelah "be" pasif wajib V3. "explain" adalah kata kerja beraturan, V3-nya "explained", bukan bentuk dasar "explain".

q: Manakah kalimat berikut yang SUDAH benar (tidak perlu diperbaiki)?
opts: A traditional ceremony was held in the village last week.
The accident was happened during the event.
The report is wrote by her yesterday.
The house was build in 1990.
explain: "hold" (V3 = held) dipasifkan dengan benar untuk Simple Past: "was held", cocok dengan subjek tunggal dan signal word "last week".

q: "Look! A new bridge ___ (build) right now." Lengkapi dengan bentuk pasif yang tepat.
opts: is being built
is built
was being built
has been built
explain: "Look!" + "right now" adalah signal word Present Continuous. Rumus pasifnya: S + is/am/are + being + V3 → "is being built".

q: "By next year, this school ___ (renovate) completely." Lengkapi dengan bentuk pasif yang tepat.
opts: will be renovated
will have been renovated
is being renovated
was renovated
explain: "By next year" adalah signal word Future Perfect (aksi selesai sebelum titik waktu tertentu di masa depan). Rumus pasifnya: S + will + have + been + V3.

q: "The cake ___ (eat) by the guests before the party even started." Lengkapi dengan bentuk pasif yang tepat.
opts: was eaten
had been eaten
has been eaten
is eaten
explain: Aksi ini selesai SEBELUM aksi lain di masa lalu ("the party started") → Past Perfect. Rumus pasifnya: S + had + been + V3 → "had been eaten".

q: Manakah kalimat pasif yang menunjukkan aksi yang MASIH BERLANGSUNG di masa lalu (bukan sudah selesai)?
opts: The letter was written by him.
The letter was being written by him.
The letter has been written by him.
The letter will be written by him.
explain: "was being written" (Past Continuous pasif) menunjukkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung di suatu titik waktu tertentu di masa lalu, bukan aksi yang sudah selesai.

q: Kata kerja mana yang bisa dipasifkan karena punya objek (transitive)?
opts: sleep
die
repair
exist
explain: "repair" adalah kata kerja transitif (butuh objek, misalnya "repair the car"), jadi bisa dipasifkan: "The car was repaired." sleep, die, dan exist semuanya intransitif.

q: "The money ___ (steal) from the safe last night, but the police haven't found the thief yet." Lengkapi dengan bentuk pasif yang tepat.
opts: is stolen
was stolen
steals
will be stolen
explain: "last night" adalah signal word Simple Past. Rumus pasifnya: S + was/were + V3 → "was stolen".

q: Manakah alasan yang PALING tepat kenapa kalimat berita/ilmiah sering pakai passive voice?
opts: Supaya kalimatnya lebih panjang dan terlihat rumit
Supaya fokus pembaca ada di aksi/hasil, bukan siapa pelakunya
Karena aturan tata bahasa mewajibkan semua berita pakai passive
Supaya kalimatnya lebih mudah dihafal
explain: Passive voice memindahkan fokus dari pelaku ke aksi/objek yang menerima aksi — cocok untuk berita/ilmiah yang ingin menonjolkan peristiwa/hasil, bukan siapa yang melakukannya.

q: "He teaches us English." Manakah bentuk pasif yang paling natural?
opts: English is taught us by him.
We are taught English by him.
We teach English by him.
English teaches us by him.
explain: Kata kerja berobjek dua ("teach"), objek orang ("us" → "we") jadi subjek pasif adalah bentuk yang paling natural: "We are taught English by him."

q: "He teaches us English." Manakah bentuk pasif kedua yang juga benar?
opts: English is taught to us by him.
English is taught for us by him.
English teaches to us by him.
We are taught to English by him.
explain: "teach" memakai preposisi "to" di pasif kedua (objek benda jadi subjek): "English is taught to us by him."

q: Manakah pernyataan yang PALING tepat tentang "by + agent" dalam kalimat pasif?
opts: Wajib selalu ada di setiap kalimat pasif
Sifatnya opsional — boleh dicantumkan atau dihilangkan tergantung apakah pelakunya penting diketahui
Hanya boleh dipakai di kalimat tanya
Selalu diletakkan di awal kalimat
explain: "By + agent" bersifat opsional: dicantumkan kalau pelakunya penting/relevan, dihilangkan kalau tidak diketahui/tidak penting/sudah jelas dari konteks.

q: "This bridge ___ (build) in 1975." Lengkapi dengan bentuk pasif yang tepat, dan tunjukkan alasan "by + agent" boleh dihilangkan.
opts: was built — karena siapa kontraktornya tidak relevan untuk kalimat ini
is built — karena kejadiannya masih berlangsung
will be built — karena kejadiannya di masa depan
has built — karena kejadiannya baru selesai
explain: "in 1975" = signal word Simple Past → "was built". Siapa yang membangunnya tidak disebut karena tidak relevan untuk informasi yang ingin disampaikan (kapan jembatan itu dibangun).

q: Manakah kalimat yang menggunakan get-passive dengan tepat dalam konteks percakapan santai?
opts: The annual report got submitted to the board of directors.
She got hurt during the football match.
The treaty got signed by both governments.
The policy got announced in the official gazette.
explain: "got hurt" cocok untuk get-passive: kejadian tiba-tiba/tak terduga dalam konteks santai. Opsi lain (laporan tahunan, perjanjian resmi, kebijakan pemerintah) semuanya konteks formal yang seharusnya tetap pakai be-passive.

q: "The window ___ (break) by the storm last night." Lengkapi dengan bentuk pasif yang tepat.
opts: is broken
was broken
breaks
has broken
explain: "last night" = signal word Simple Past. "break" → V3 "broken". Rumus pasif: S + was/were + V3 → "was broken".

q: Manakah dari kalimat berikut yang merupakan bentuk pasif Present Perfect yang benar?
opts: The car has repaired by the mechanic.
The car has been repaired by the mechanic.
The car is repaired by the mechanic.
The car had repaired by the mechanic.
explain: Present Perfect pasif: S + has/have + been + V3. "has been repaired" adalah bentuk yang benar — jangan lupa "been" di antara "has" dan V3.

q: Kenapa "The results were happened as expected." salah, dan apa perbaikannya?
opts: "happen" intransitif, tidak bisa dipasifkan → "The results happened as expected."
"be" seharusnya "was" bukan "were" → "The results was happened as expected."
Seharusnya ditambah "by" → "The results were happened by as expected."
Kalimat ini sudah benar
explain: "happen" tidak punya objek (intransitif), jadi tidak bisa dipasifkan sama sekali — harus tetap dalam bentuk aktif: "The results happened as expected."

q: "The bridge was designed." vs "The bridge was designed by Ir. Sedyatmo." — mana yang lebih tepat kalau konteksnya sedang membahas kontribusi Ir. Sedyatmo pada dunia teknik sipil Indonesia?
opts: Kedua kalimat sama-sama tepat, tidak ada bedanya
"The bridge was designed." — karena passive selalu menghilangkan agent
"The bridge was designed by Ir. Sedyatmo." — karena nama perancangnya adalah info penting dalam konteks ini
Tidak ada yang tepat, harus pakai active voice
explain: Ketika pelakunya adalah informasi yang relevan/penting untuk disampaikan (di sini: kontribusi Ir. Sedyatmo), "by + agent" wajib dipertahankan, bukan dihilangkan.

q: "Many endangered animals ___ (protect) by this new law starting next year." Lengkapi dengan bentuk pasif yang tepat.
opts: will be protected
are protected
were protected
have been protected
explain: "starting next year" = signal word Simple Future. Rumus pasif: S + will + be + V3 → "will be protected".

q: Manakah yang merupakan pasangan modal-passive yang benar untuk "You should not ignore this warning."
opts: This warning should not ignore.
This warning should not be ignored.
This warning should not be ignoring.
This warning is should not ignored.
explain: Modal negatif passive: modal + not + be + V3. "should not be ignored" adalah bentuk yang benar.
